_comment: Rule-based standards screening (NOT AI). General-honey limits only; special honey types have different limits noted in 'exceptions'. Select the profile with STANDARDS_PROFILE (default FSSAI).

FSSAI.name: FSSAI (India) honey standard
FSSAI.source: FSS (Food Products Standards & Food Additives) Regulations 2011, reg. 2.8.3 as amended (honey standards notified 2018, operationalised 2020); FSSAI advisory 07-Nov-2025 on HMF (max 80 mg/kg)

checks.label: Sucrose
checks.exceptions: 10 g/100 g for Carvia callosa and honeydew honey

CODEX.name: Codex Alimentarius CXS 12-1981 (Rev. 2001)
CODEX.source: Revised Codex Standard for Honey, CODEX STAN 12-1981, Rev.1 (1987), Rev.2 (2001)

checks.label: Sucrose
checks.exceptions: 10 or 15 g/100 g for listed floral sources (e.g. citrus, alfalfa, lavender, borage)

checks.label: HMF
checks.exceptions: 80 mg/kg for honey of declared tropical origin
